column2: we need to finish one block group to make room to activate a

column1: new block group.
However
column2: we cannot do this for metadata block groups because we can cause a

column1: deadlock by waiting for a running transaction commit. So
a data block group.
Furthermore
column2: the block group to be finished has two requirements. First

column1: the block group must not have reserved bytes left. Having reserved bytes

region is allocated by the thread calling btrfs_zone_finish()

Second
column2: the block group to be finished must not be a SYSTEM block

column1: group. Finishing a SYSTEM block group easily breaks further chunk
allocation by nullifying the SYSTEM free space.
